source_title: 'Jisko nahi fly karna woh nikal lo': Airline staff's reply to safety concerns
source_excerpt: A video showing a heated exchange between SpiceJet staff and passengers over a seemingly loose aircraft window panel has gone viral on social media. The confrontation began after passengers noticed what appeared to be a loose covering near a window and questioned whether the aircraft was safe to fly. A staff member's blunt response, reportedly telling those uncomfortable with flying to leave, has drawn criticism online. The video, which has been widely shared on social media was first posted by the Instagram account @aircrew.in, shows a woman passenger pointing towards the window area and asking the staff member to explain why the covering appeared to be loose. Other passengers also joined the conversation, questioning the condition of the aircraft and seeking reassurance before travelling.As the disagreement escalated, one passenger said they wanted to record the exchange. The staff member allowed them to film while continuing to maintain that there was no safety issue. When passengers questioned how he could guarantee their safety, he reportedly said that he was taking responsibility for the aircraft's safety. The staff member's response, particularly the remark suggesting that passengers who did not wish to fly could leave, became a major talking point. Travellers appeared unhappy with what they perceived as a dismissal of a legitimate safety concern.What exactly was wrong with the aircraft window?While the footage has prompted questions about aircraft maintenance, the precise nature of the component seen in the video remains unclear. Reports describing the incident refer to a loose window covering or concealment, with some mentioning tape around the area. Importantly, an aircraft's interior window panel is not the same as its external structural window. The video does not establish whether the visible issue involved only an interior fitting or something that could affect the aircraft's airworthiness.Social media divided over staff member's responseThe incident has triggered mixed reactions online. While several viewers questioned the way the staff member handled the passengers' concerns, others defended him, arguing that the visible issue might not necessarily have posed a safety risk.Some users also pointed out that passengers should be given a clear explanation whenever they raise concerns about an aircraft's condition, rather than being made to feel that they have to choose between travelling and leaving. The incident has once again brought attention to the importance of communication between airline staff and passengers, particularly when questions about flight safety arise.Passengers who are traveling on an aircraft possess the right to voice their concerns regarding any anomalies or unusual occurrences within the airplane, especially in the critical period leading up to take-off. It is the responsibility of the airline personnel to respond to these inquiries with a composed demeanor and to relay any technical issues to the designated maintenance or flight operations teams. Even in situations where the matter pertains to a non-structural element inside the cabin, providing a clear explanation about its function and clarifying why it poses no threat to flight safety can significantly help in alleviating any undue anxiety among the passengers. Consequently, this situation has sparked broader questions not only regarding the physical state of the aircraft but also about the effectiveness and clarity of communication from airlines when passengers seek reassurance and information.As per the most recent reports that are available, there has yet to be any verification from independent sources regarding the findings from the aircraft's inspection, nor has there been an official statement released that defines the specific nature of the issue related to the windows.You use AI every day.
